result.summary: Clip 1 (00:00–00:08) shows a daytime match between a team in royal blue attacking to the right and a team in white defending. At 00:09, the footage cuts to a night match under floodlights featuring a team in white and a team in dark kits, where no royal blue outfield kit is present. Shirt numbers are not legible across the footage, and on-screen spotlight graphics highlight a player in white rather than blue, so basis is set to none.

observations.title: Turnover in the attacking half
observations.body: In the daylight sequence, the blue team advances into the attacking third before white intervenes centrally and clears toward the right flank. Blue maintains a compact shape behind the ball to contest the clearance.

observations.title: Mid-clip cut to different match
observations.body: The broadcast cuts from the daytime fixture to a night fixture under floodlights with entirely different kits (white against dark). Identification does not carry over across this cut.

observations.title: Central transition into attacking space
observations.body: In the second fixture, the team in white breaks through midfield and plays forward into the right channel as the front runner moves across the defensive line to receive.
